purpose: Test the confirmed GIADA hybrid data recipe at the same 600,000-transition scale as frozen S1 before authorizing S2.

families: BAP assist-only and soma-only/combined causal contrasts

rationale.two_physical_subcorpora: Long stochastic trajectories preserve slow rate modulation; short targeted episodes avoid thousands of empty post-stimulus transitions.
rationale.logical_composite: Models sample one verified corpus without copying or physically merging HDF5 shards.
rationale.mixture: Sixty percent background preserves broad naturalistic coverage, while forty percent targeted support prevents rare nonlinear regimes from disappearing from validation.
rationale.aligned_comparison: GIADA and Branch-ELM receive the same numerical tensors, samples, targets, loss, optimizer family and seeds.

anti_leakage.split_unit: complete trajectory or complete paired episode group
anti_leakage.validation_role: development model comparison, not fresh paper test

decision_rule: S2 may be considered only if both components validate, every preregistered support gate passes, and the aligned S1e GPU comparison is complete. A failed gate triggers a minimal prospective repair, never post-hoc resplitting.
